blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Code-switching (CS), the alternation between languages within an utterance, is common in multilingual speech but underrepresented in pretraining corpora. Increasing CS coverage requires finding relevant utterances in large speech collections so that they can be included in training data. One way to find such utterances is to transcribe the speech and detect language alternation in the text, but this depends on obtaining accurate multilingual transcriptions. We propose a lightweight method that detects CS directly from speech. It uses frame-level language information in pretrained speech encoders to determine whether both languages are present within an utterance. Specifically, we identify language-selective hidden-state dimensions using monolingual recordings and aggregate their frame-level activations into a CS prediction. With a small CS set used to tune a decision rule, we show that the Whisper-small encoder achieves a mean F1 of $0.798$ across 14 language pairs in CS-FLEURS, compared with $0.776$ for a CNN and $0.751$ for a HuBERT linear baseline trained for monolingual language identification. Our findings suggest that pretrained speech encoders already encode the information needed to identify CS utterances, and they provide a lightweight tool for building more representative multilingual corpora.
blocks.zh: 代码切换(CS),一种语境中语言之间的交替,在多语种语音中很常见,但在预训Corpora中代表不足. 扩大CS的覆盖范围要求在大型语音收集中找到相关言论,以便将其纳入培训数据。 找到这种言论的一种方法是在文字中转录语音并检测语言交替,但这取决于能否获得准确的多语种转录. 我们提出一种轻量级方法,直接从语音中检测出CS. 它在预先训练的语音编码器中使用帧级语言信息,以确定两种语言是否都存在于一个语音中. 具体来说,我们用单一语言的录音来识别语言选择性隐藏状态维度,并将其帧级活化为CS预测. 使用一个小的CS集来调制一个决定规则,我们显示,Whisper-小编码器在CS-FLEURS的14个语言对中实现平均F1为0.798美元,而CNN为0.776美元,HuBERT为单一语言识别培训的线性基线为0.751美元。 我们的调查结果表明,预先训练的语音编码器已经编码了识别CS语音所需的信息,它们为建设更具代表性的多语种公司提供了轻量级工具。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multilingual speech corpora cover many languages but often contain few code-switched (CS) utterances. As a result, models trained on these corpora have limited exposure to mixed-language speech. Recent work shows that training or adapting ASR systems with CS data improves recognition of such speech [ 12 , 15 , 22 ] . A recent study introducing CS-YODAS, a dataset of naturally occurring CS speech mined from the large multilingual YODAS speech corpus, also reports gains in spoken language identification when this speech is added to training [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 多种语言的语音corpora涵盖许多语言,但往往包含很少的代码切换(CS)语音. 因此,接受过这些"蝎子"培训的模型对混合语言演讲的曝光有限. 近期的研究表明,使用CS数据培训或调整ASR系统可提高这类语音的识别性[12、15、22]。 最近的一项研究介绍了CS-YODS,这是一套从大型多语种YODS语音教程中挖掘出来的自然出现的CS语音数据集,该研究还报告,在将这种语音添加到培训中时,在口头语言识别方面有所进展[21]。

blocks.en: Existing corpora such as SEAME [ 13 ] , the Miami corpora [ 5 ] , and the South African soap-opera corpus [ 19 ] provide natural CS speech, but the amount available for training is limited by their size, language-pair coverage, and the proportion of recordings that contain a switch. For example, only 8% of utterances in the Miami corpus are code-switched. Even in SEAME, where some interview questions were designed to elicit code-switching, the reported proportion is 52% [ 2 ] . Therefore, larger multilingual CS benchmarks have relied mainly on read or synthetic speech [ 6 , 8 , 20 ] . Mining CS utterances from larger speech collections could provide more natural examples across languages and domains.
blocks.zh: SEAME [13],迈阿密Corpora [5]等现存公司,南非肥皂-口服[19]提供了自然的CS语音,但可用于培训的金额受到其大小,语言-pair覆盖,以及包含开关的录音比例的限制. 例如,迈阿密案卷中只有8%的言论是密码转换的。 即使在SEAME,一些访谈问题旨在引起代码交换,报告的比例是52%[2]。 因此,更大的多语种CS基准主要依靠读取或合成语 [6, 8, 20]. 大型演讲集的CS语句可以提供语言和领域的更自然的例子。

blocks.en: Mining CS utterances from a large speech collection requires identifying which recordings contain CS. CS-YODAS [ 21 ] shows that natural CS speech can be mined from web audio using a pipeline that uses ASR transcripts, a 14B-parameter language model, and bilingual human feedback. Having access to a model that can detect CS directly from speech can be beneficial as a pre-filter before running more expensive parts of the pipeline. We therefore investigate whether CS can be detected directly from speech with a lightweight binary detector.
blocks.zh: 大型演讲集的CS采矿言论要求确定哪些录音包含CS. CS-YODS [21] 显示,自然 CS 语音可以用使用 ASR 语录的管道从网络音频中挖掘出,使用14B参数语言模型,以及双语人类反馈. 能够直接从语音中检测出CS的型号,在运行更昂贵的管线部分之前作为预过滤器是有好处的. 因此,我们调查CS能否用轻量级二进制探测器直接从语音中检测出.

blocks.en: Prior work has shown that frame-level hidden representations of pretrained speech models encode information about spoken language [ 4 ] . In this work, we ask whether this frame-level information can be used to detect whether code-switching has occurred within a given utterance. Our approach proceeds in two steps: we first identify hidden-state dimensions in a pretrained speech encoder whose activations differ between the target languages, using a small set of monolingual recordings; then, at test time, we monitor these same dimensions to predict whether a switch in language occurs within a given utterance. We study the utility of this approach and show that it yields an effective CS detector.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作表明,帧层隐含了预先训练的语音模型编码口语信息[4]. 在这项工作中,我们询问这种帧级信息是否可以用来检测某一个语句中是否发生了代码切换. 我们的方法分两个步骤进行:我们首先在经过预先训练的语音编码器中识别出隐藏状态的维度,其激活在目标语言之间有所不同,使用一小组单一语言的录音;然后,在测试时,我们监测这些相同的维度,以预测语言切换是否发生在给定的语音内. 我们研究这种方法的效用,并表明它会产生有效的CS探测器.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: CS can be detected from speech without first transcribing it. Systems trained on labelled monolingual and CS speech have been evaluated for utterance-level detection on three English–Indian-language pairs, as well as for frame-level language identification [ 18 ] . CS language identification has also been studied on English–Mandarin child-directed speech using CNN–GRU models and ASR-assisted pretraining [ 11 ] . These systems are developed and evaluated for specific language pairs and speech settings. Applying a trained CS detector to a new pair may require labelled CS examples, which can be difficult to obtain before mining begins.
blocks.zh: CS可以从语音中检测出而无需先翻录. 已对关于标有单一语言和CS语言的系统进行了评估,以对三对英语-印度语的对口进行语音检测,并对框架语言识别进行了[18]。 CS语言识别也被研究英语–使用CNN-GRU模型和ASR辅助预训的曼达林儿童指导演讲 [11]. 这些系统是为特定语言配对和语音设置而开发和评价的. 将训练有素的CS探测器应用到一对新相机上可能需要贴有标签的CS实例,在开始开采前可能很难获得.

blocks.en: Language diarization offers another way to mine samples with CS by assigning language labels to temporal regions of speech. An end-to-end approach adapted from speaker diarization trains on CS utterances with language labels at 200 ms intervals, but reports a substantial performance drop from synthetic to recorded speech, partly attributed to differences in segment duration [ 14 ] . Another approach fine-tunes speech representations on 14.3 hours of annotated South African soap-opera speech spanning English and four other languages; approximately 4.5 hours of CS speech are in its training set [ 7 ] . The DISPLACE challenges evaluate diarization on multilingual conversational speech [ 1 , 10 ] , with one strong system fine-tuning its language representations on in-domain data [ 9 ] . These results show that language boundaries can be recovered from speech, while also illustrating the role of annotated CS data and recording conditions. We examine whether likely CS utterances can instead be identified using dimensions selected from monolingual speech and a small labelled CS set for tuning. We test this approach across language pairs and on conversational speech from a second domain.
blocks.zh: 语言分化通过将语言标签分配给时空语音区域,为用CS来开采样品提供了另一种方式. 由CS发音上配有200ms相距语言标签的扬声道对接列车改编而来的一种端到端方法,但报告性能从合成语音大幅下滑到有录音的语音,部分归因于段长相差[14]. 另一种做法是对14.3小时附有注释的南非肥皂-口服语言(包括英语和其他四种语言)的演讲进行微调;大约4.5小时的CS演讲在培训集中[7]。 DISPLACE挑战评价了多语种对话言论的分化[1,10],一个强大的系统在域内数据上微调了语言表现[9]. 这些结果显示,语言边界可以从语音中恢复,同时也说明了附加注释的CS数据和记录条件的作用. 我们研究是否可以用从单一语言语言语言中选择的维度来识别可能的 CS 语句,以及一个带有小标签的 CS 设置来调音 。 我们测试这个方法 跨语言对 和谈话演讲 从第二个领域。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we describe how we identify language-selective dimensions in a pretrained speech model and use this information to detect CS. We first measure how each dimension’s activations differ between two languages in monolingual speech. We then test whether the same dimensions are selective across language pairs. Finally, we use their frame-level activations to predict whether an utterance contains CS. We use monolingual speech to select dimensions and estimate language centroids, and code-switched speech to evaluate the detector and tune its decision rule. The corpora, language pairs, and data splits used for each step are described in Section 4
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们描述了我们如何在经过预先训练的语音模型中识别语言选择性维度,并使用这些信息来检测CS. 我们首先衡量每个维度的激活在单一语言语言中两种语言之间的差异。 然后我们测试同一维度是否具有跨语言对的选择性. 最后,我们用他们的帧级活化来预测一个语音是否包含CS. 我们使用单语语音来选择维度和估计语言的百分位机器人,并用代码开关语音来评价探测器并调谐其决定规则. 第4节说明了每个步骤所用的公司、语言对等和数据分割。

blocks.zh: 3.1 语言选择层面

blocks.en: 3.3 Code-Switching Detection
blocks.zh: 3.3 密码交换检测

blocks.en: We use the selected dimensions to obtain a language score for each frame. Monolingual speech establishes the typical activations for languages A A and B B along a language axis; frames closer to each language’s centroid on this axis receive scores in opposite directions. We then test whether the utterance contains sufficient local evidence for each language.

blocks.en: We use a 0.5-second sliding window with a 0.1-second stride. Within each window, p A p_{A} and p B p_{B} are the fractions of frames with positive and negative scores, respectively. We classify an utterance as code-switched if at least n n windows satisfy p A ≥ θ p_{A}\geq\theta and at least n n windows satisfy p B ≥ θ p_{B}\geq\theta . These need not be consecutive windows. We tune θ \theta and n n on a small labelled set, as described in Section 4 .
4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Data
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据

blocks.en: We use three speech corpora. SEAME [ 13 ] contains approximately 192 hours of spontaneous Mandarin–English speech from 156 speakers in Singapore and Malaysia. We use monolingual training utterances to select encoder layers, estimate English and Mandarin centroids, and train the three baselines. We evaluate CS detection on its two official development sets, dev_man (Mandarin-dominant) and dev_sge (Singapore English-dominant).
blocks.zh: 我们用三个说话的蝎子。 SEAME [13] 收录了大约192小时自发的普通话 — 新加坡和马来西亚156个演讲者的英语演讲. 我们使用单一语言的训练语句来选择编码层,估计英语和普通话的百分行星,并训练出三个基线. 我们评价CS探测器的两套官方开发软件:dev_man(英语:dev_man (mandarin-dominant))和dev_sge(新加坡英语-dominant).

blocks.en: FLEURS [ 3 ] contains read speech in 102 languages. We use monolingual training utterances from English and the 14 non-English languages in our CS-FLEURS evaluation. These 15 languages form 105 pairs for the cross-pair recurrence analysis. The same training utterances are used for pair-specific dimension selection, centroid estimation, and baseline training.
blocks.zh: FLEURS [3] 包含102种语言的读取语音. 在CS-FLEURS的评价中,我们使用英语和14种非英语的单一语言培训语言。 这15种语言组成了105对用于跨pair重现分析. 同样的培训语句用于对等尺寸选择、中间行星估计和基线培训。

blocks.en: CS-FLEURS [ 20 ] contains read and synthetic CS speech, covering 113 language pairs and 52 languages in total. We evaluate only on its read-speech portion, using 14 English–X pairs.
blocks.zh: CS-FLEURS [20] 包含读取和合成CS语音,共涵盖113个语言对和52个语言. 我们只用14对英语来评估它的读写部分。

blocks.en: For both evaluation corpora, CS utterances are used to tune the detection rule and compute CS detection F1. Neither corpus contributes CS utterances to dimension selection or centroid estimation.
blocks.zh: 对于两个评价的Corpora,CS发音都用于调谐检测规则并计算CS检测F1. 两者都不有助于CS对维数选择或中间行星估计的表述。

blocks.en: 4.2 Pretrained Models
blocks.zh: 4.2 预先训练的模式

blocks.en: We study three pretrained multilingual speech encoders with different training objectives and language coverage. Whisper-small [ 17 ] is trained with supervised multitask learning that includes predicting a language token. It covers approximately 100 languages and has a hidden size of d = 768 d=768 . mHuBERT-147 [ 23 ] uses self-supervised masked prediction on speech from 147 languages, without an explicit language identification objective ( d = 768 d=768 ). MMS-1B [ 16 ] uses wav2vec2.0-style contrastive pretraining on 1,406 languages ( d = 1,280 d=1{,}280 ).
blocks.zh: 我们研究三个经过预先培训的多语种语音编码器,它们具有不同的培训目标和语言覆盖范围。 Whisper-small [17] 接受有监督的多任务学习培训,包括预测语言符号. 它涵盖约100种语言,并有隐藏大小为d=768 d=768. mHuBERT-147 [23] 对147种语言的语音使用自我监督的口罩预测,没有明确的语言识别目标(d=768 d=768). MMS-1B [16] 对1,406种语言使用wav2vec2.0风格的对比预训(d=1,280 d=1{,}280).

blocks.en: 4.3 Layer and Dimension Selection
blocks.zh: 4.3 层和尺寸选择

blocks.en: For each model, we select one encoder layer using monolingual SEAME training speech, so the layer is not chosen to maximise cross-pair recurrence on FLEURS. We sample 300 English and 300 Mandarin utterances, compute Cohen’s d d for every dimension at every layer, and select the layer with the highest peak selectivity. Three independent samples of 300 utterances per language selected the same layer.
blocks.zh: 对于每个模型,我们选择一个使用单语言SEAME训练演讲的编码器层,因此该层没有被选中来在FLEURS上最大限度地实现交叉pair重现. 我们抽取了300个英语和300个普通话,计算科恩每层的维度,并以最高选择性选择层。 每个语言有3个独立标本300个语句选择同一层.

blocks.en: We keep this layer fixed for the remaining analyses. To measure cross-pair recurrence, we sample 300 training utterances from each of the 15 FLEURS languages and compute Cohen’s d d for all 105 pairs. We then rank dimensions by their recurrence score (Eq. 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们把这个层固定在剩下的分析上。 为了衡量交叉重复,我们从15种FLEURS语言中抽取了300个培训语句,并对所有105对语言计算出科恩的d. 然后,我们按它们的再现分数排列维度(Eq. 2)。

blocks.en: For CS detection, we compare two ways of selecting K K dimensions. Recurring dimensions uses the dimensions with the highest cross-pair recurrence, with the same indices for every target pair. Pair-specific dimensions uses the dimensions with the highest Cohen’s d d for each target pair, selected from its monolingual training speech. We set K = 8 K{=}8 for the two models with d = 768 d{=}768 and K = 13 K{=}13 for MMS-1B with d = 1,280 d{=}1{,}280 . For both strategies, language centroids are estimated from monolingual speech in the corpus used for the corresponding evaluation.
blocks.zh: 对于CS检测,我们比较两种选择K维度的方法. 反复维度使用跨岸重现率最高的维度,每对目标具有相同的指数. 专有对等的维度使用每个目标对中最高的Cohen dd的维度,从单一语言的训练演讲中选择. 我们为两种型号设定了K=8 K{=}8,其中d=768 d{=}768和K=13 K{=}13,MMS-1B为d=1,280 d{=}1{,}280. 在这两种战略中,语言百分数是根据用于相应评估的教程中的单语语音来估计的。

blocks.en: 4.4 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.4 基线

blocks.en: We compare with three classifiers trained to identify the target languages from monolingual speech. Each produces frame-level language predictions at inference, which we aggregate into a CS decision using the same sliding-window rule as our method.
blocks.zh: 我们与经过培训的3个分类人员进行比较,以便从单一语言语言语言中识别目标语言。 每一个都产生帧级语言预测在推论中,我们利用与我们的方法相同的滑窗规则,将其汇总为CS决定.

blocks.en: CNN is a four-layer 1D convolutional network operating on 80-dimensional log-Mel features extracted with a 25 ms window and 10 ms shift. Each layer has 256 channels and a kernel size of 5, followed by batch normalization and ReLU. The model is trained with utterance-level language labels using cross-entropy and Adam ( lr = 10 − 3 \mathrm{lr}{=}10^{-3} ) for 30 epochs. HuBERT linear is a two-class linear head trained on mean-pooled representations from frozen HuBERT-base ( d = 768 d{=}768 ), using the same optimizer and number of epochs. At inference, the head is applied to each frame. Full-layer probe uses the same training and inference procedure with frozen Whisper-small layer 8 representations ( d = 768 d{=}768 ). It tests whether a classifier trained on the full layer performs better than using a small set of selected dimensions. 2 2 2 We also evaluated a linear head on mHuBERT-147 representations, but it performed worse than the HuBERT-base. Both HuBERT linear and full-layer probe achieve near-perfect monolingual LID accuracy on FLEURS
blocks.zh: CNN是一个四层一维分解网络,运行于80维的log-Mel特性上,取出有25ms窗口和10ms相变. 每层有256个通道,内核大小为5个,再接批量正常化和ReLU. 该模型通过使用横琴和亚当(lr = 10 – 3\mathrm{lr}{=}10^{-3})的语音级语言标签进行训练,为30个纪元. HuBERT线性是受冷冻的HuBERT-base(d = 768 d{=}768)中平均集合表示法训练的双等线性头部,使用相同的优化器和时代数. 推断出,头被应用在每个框架上. 全层探测器使用相同的训练和推论程序,并有冷冻的Whisper-小层8表示(d=768 d{=}768). 它测试一个在全层上受过训练的分类器是否比使用一小组所选择的维度表现更好. 2,2,我们还评估了mHuBERT-147表示的线性头部,但表现比HuBERT-基部更差. HuBERT线性和全层探测器在FLEURS上都实现了近乎完美的单语言LID精度

blocks.en: For CS-FLEURS, we train each baseline separately for each language pair on monolingual FLEURS training utterances. For SEAME, we train them on monolingual English and Mandarin utterances from its training set. We balance the two languages by subsampling each to min ⁡ ( n A , n B ) \min(n_{A},n_{B}) utterances. On SEAME, this leaves over 22,000 training utterances per language for each baseline, compared with 300 per language for dimension selection.
blocks.zh: 就CS-FLEURS而言,我们用单一语言的FLEURS培训语句,对每种语言的组合分别进行每个基线培训。 对SEAME来说,我们从培训中对他们进行单一语言英语和普通话语言培训。 我们通过对每个语言进行子抽样到分秒(nA,nB)\min(n_{A},n_{B})的语句来平衡两种语言. 在SEAME方面,每个基线的每个语言的训练语数超过22,000个,而每个语言的尺寸选择则有300个。

blocks.en: 4.5 Code-Switching Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.5 代码交换评价

blocks.en: We report utterance-level F1 for CS detection. We select the threshold θ \theta and minimum window count n n by grid search over θ ∈ { 0.05 , 0.10 , … , 0.95 } \theta\in\{0.05,0.10,\ldots,0.95\} and n ∈ { 1 , … , 5 } n\in\{1,\ldots,5\} . We report two settings. Oracle selects the parameters that maximise F1 on the full evaluation set. Calibration tests parameter selection with limited labelled data. For CS-FLEURS, we select ( θ , n ) (\theta,n) on a random 10% of evaluation utterances and evaluate on the remaining 90%. For SEAME, we select ( θ , n ) (\theta,n) on 200 randomly sampled CS training utterances and an equal number of monolingual training utterances, then evaluate on the development sets. We repeat each calibration procedure 200 times and report mean F1 and standard deviation.

Table 1: Utterance-level CS detection F1. Oracle parameters are selected on the evaluation set; calibrated parameters are selected from limited labelled data. Calibrated results show mean and standard deviation over 200 repetitions.
blocks.zh: 表1:Utterance级CS检测F1. 在评价集中选择甲骨文参数;从有限的标签数据中选择校正参数. 经校正的结果显示了200多起重复的平均值和标准偏差。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: We first examine whether language-selective dimensions recur across pairs and recording domains. If they do, the same dimensions may provide language information for CS detection beyond the pair on which they were identified. We then test this possibility through utterance-level CS detection, per-pair results, and transfer to held-out pairs.
blocks.zh: 我们首先审查语言选择性维度是否在对接和记录域之间重复出现。 如果是的话,同样的维度可能提供语言信息,用于CS检测,超出被识别的对等. 然后我们通过口语CS检测测试这种可能性,每片结果,以及转移到被搁置的对子.

blocks.en: 5.1 Language-Selective Dimensions Recur Across Pairs
blocks.zh: 5.1 语文选择尺寸

blocks.en: We first ask whether dimensions selected for one language pair also rank highly for others. If so, the same dimensions may support CS detection across pairs, rather than requiring an unrelated set for each one. Across the 105 FLEURS pairs, the most frequently selected dimension ranks in the top 1 % 1\% for 55.2% of pairs in Whisper-small, 26.7% in mHuBERT-147, and 16.2% in MMS-1B. The corresponding Monte Carlo chance levels are 5.3% ( ± 0.7 % \pm 0.7\% ) for the 768-dimensional models and 5.5% ( ± 0.7 % \pm 0.7\% ) for MMS-1B. Recurrence is highest in Whisper-small, although differences in objective, language coverage, and training data prevent us from attributing this result to one aspect of pretraining.
blocks.zh: 我们首先问,为一种语言选取的维度是否也为其他语言高排一等。 如果是这样,同样的维度可能支持CS对子的检测,而不是要求每个对子都有一个不相干的集. 在105个FLEURS配对中,最常被选取的维度在Whisper-Small55.2%的配对中排在前1%,在mHuBERT-147中排在前26.7%,在MMS-1B中排在前16.2%. 相应的蒙特卡洛机会水平为:768维模型为5.3% (±0.7%\pm 0.7%),MMS-1B为5.5% (±0.7%\pm 0.7%). 尽管在目标、语言覆盖面和培训数据上的差异使我们无法将这一结果归因于预先培训的一个方面,但Whisper-small的重复率最高。

blocks.en: 5.2 Some Recurring Dimensions Remain Selective Across Domains
blocks.zh: 5.2 某些反复出现的问题仍然有选择

blocks.en: We examine the recurring Whisper-small dimensions more closely. At layer8, dimensions 75, 332, and 704 rank in the top eight for 55.2%, 51.4%, and 51.4% of the 105 pairs, respectively; dimensions 398 and 466 also recur frequently. This raises a further question for CS detection: do dimensions selected from read speech remain selective in conversational speech?
blocks.zh: 我们更仔细地研究反复出现的微声小维度。 第8层,维度75,332和704分别排在前8名55.2%,51.4%和51.4%的105对;维度398和466也频繁重现. 这提出了CS检测的另一个问题:从读取的语音中选择的维度在对话语音中是否仍然是选择性的?

blocks.en: For English–Mandarin, per-dimension Cohen’s d d rankings on FLEURS and SEAME have a weak Spearman correlation of ρ = 0.251 \rho{=}0.251 . Three of the eight most recurring dimensions nevertheless rank in the top eight in both corpora. Dimension 332 ranks first in SEAME, while dimensions 75 and 398 rank in the top seven in both. Other dimensions transfer less consistently: dimension 704 ranks 24th in FLEURS and 26th in SEAME for this pair, whereas dimension 466 falls from 118th to 741st. Thus, some highly recurring dimensions remain selective across domains, but recurrence alone does not guarantee domain stability.
blocks.zh: 英语- 普通话, 普通话 科恩的dd排名在FLEURS和SEAME上,斯皮尔曼的关联度微弱为: ^0.251\rho{=}0.251. 8个最反复出现的维度中,有3个在两个公司中排在前8名。 332尺寸在SEAME中名列第一,而75和398尺寸在两者中都排在前七. 其他维度转移不太一致:704维度在FLEURS中排第24位,在SEAME中排第26位,而466维度则从118位下降到741位. 因此,一些高度反复出现的问题仍然有不同领域的选择性,但单是重复并不能保证域的稳定。

blocks.en: 5.3 Selected Dimensions Detect CS in Read and Conversational Speech
blocks.zh: 5.3 阅读和对话发言中检测 CS 的选定尺寸

blocks.en: Table 1 reports utterance-level CS detection F1. On CS-FLEURS, Whisper-small reaches the highest mean oracle F1, 0.798 0.798 , using eight pair-specific dimensions. It exceeds the CNN ( 0.776 0.776 ), HuBERT linear ( 0.751 0.751 ), and full-layer Whisper-small probe ( 0.786 0.786 ). mHuBERT-147 and MMS-1B reach 0.756 0.756 and 0.762 0.762 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 表1报告了CS级检测F1. 在CS-FLEURS上,Whisper-small达到最高的平均值Oracle F1,0.798 0.798,使用8对特有尺寸. 它超过了CNN(0.776 0.776 ),HuBERT线性(0.751 0.751),以及全层的微声小探测器(0.786 0.786 ). mHuBERT-147和MMS-1B分别达到0.756 0.756和0.762 0.762.

blocks.en: With θ \theta and n n selected from 10% of labelled CS-FLEURS utterances, Whisper-small retains mean F1 of 0.784 ± 0.021 0.784\pm 0.021 , compared with 0.798 0.798 under oracle selection. This calibration subset is small for most pairs. For example, Italian–English has only 176 CS utterances in total, so a random 10% sample contains about 18 CS examples on average.
blocks.zh: Whisper-small 保留了 0.784 ± 0.021 0.784\pm 0.021 的 F1 ,而甲骨文选择下的 0.798 0.798 。 这个校正子集对于大多数对子来说都很小. 例如,意大利语–英语中只有176个CS发音,因此随机的10%样本平均包含约18个CS实例.

blocks.en: For SEAME, Table 1 reports F1 on the combined dev_man and dev_sge sets. MMS-1B has the highest oracle F1 among the dimension methods ( 0.758 0.758 ), while HuBERT linear scores highest overall ( 0.772 0.772 ). The calibrated scores are close to the corresponding oracle scores. In the split-wise results, F1 is always lower on dev_sge than on dev_man
blocks.zh: 就SEME而言,表1报告了Dev_man和dev_sge组合的F1。 MMS-1B在维度方法中拥有最高的甲骨文F1(0.758 0.758 ),而HuBERT线性分数总体最高(0.772 0.772 ). 校正分数接近相应的甲骨文分数. 在平分结果中,F1在dev_sge上总是低于dev_man上

blocks.en: 5.4 CS Detection Varies Across Language Pairs
blocks.zh: 5.4 CS 跨语言对等检测

blocks.en: Table 2 reports oracle F1 for each CS-FLEURS pair. Whisper-small ranges from 0.754 0.754 on German–English to 0.870 0.870 on Telugu–English and has the highest score on 11 of the 14 pairs. mHuBERT-147 leads on Portuguese–English ( 0.862 0.862 ) and Spanish–English ( 0.890 0.890 ), while MMS-1B leads on Telugu–English with the highest single-pair score ( 0.918 0.918 ). Whisper-small has the highest mean F1, but the strongest model differs by pair.
blocks.zh: 表2为每对CS-FLEURS报告F1。 微音小分从德文-英语的0.754 0.754到特卢古-英语的0.870 0.870,并在14对中11对得分最高. mHuBERT-147领先于葡萄牙语–英语(0.862-0.862)和西班牙语–英语(0.890-0.890),而MMS-1B领先于特卢古语–英语单曲得分最高(0.918-0.918). Whisper-small拥有最高的平分F1,但最强的型号因对而异.

blocks.en: Table 2: Utterance-level CS detection F1 for each CS-FLEURS language pair using pair-specific dimensions and oracle parameter selection.
blocks.zh: 表2:Utterance级CS检测F1,每对CS-FLEURS语言配对使用对等特有维度和甲骨文参数选择.

blocks.en: 5.5 Dimension Selection Transfers to Held-Out Pairs
blocks.zh: 5.5 向挂载出对等的大小选择转让

blocks.en: We test whether dimension indices must be selected using the target pair. For each of the 14 CS-FLEURS pairs, we rank dimensions by recurrence over a subset of the 105 FLEURS pairs using Whisper-small. Leave-X-out excludes the non-English target language, leaving 91 pairs for dimension selection. Leave-both-out excludes both target languages, leaving 78 pairs. In both conditions, we estimate centroids from monolingual speech in the target languages; only the dimension indices are selected without them.
blocks.zh: 我们检验是否必须使用目标对选择维度指数。 对于14个CS-FLEURS配对中的每一对,我们通过在105个FLEURS配对中使用Whisper-small的子集上重现来排列维度. leave-X-out排除了非英语目标语言,留下了91对来进行维度选择. 双向退出不包括两种目标语言,留有78对. 在这两种情况下,我们从目标语言的单语语音中估算出百分数;只有维度指数没有选择.

blocks.en: Leave-X-out and leave-both-out achieve mean oracle F1 of 0.797 0.797 and 0.795 0.795 , compared with 0.798 0.798 for pair-specific selection. Their calibrated scores are also similar ( 0.783 0.783 and 0.781 0.781 , compared with 0.784 0.784 ). On these 14 pairs, selecting dimensions without the target pair has little effect on CS detection F1, provided that monolingual speech from the target languages is available for centroid estimation.
blocks.zh: 出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出入出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出出 他们的校准分也相近(0.783 0.783和0.781 0.781,相较于0.784 0.784). 在这14对上,选择没有目标对等的维度对CS检测F1影响不大,前提是目标语言的单语语音可以被取用来进行中间行星估计.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present a lightweight CS detector intended for selecting candidate utterances from speech corpora. It identifies language-selective dimensions using only monolingual speech. With approximately 1 % 1\% of one Whisper-small encoder layer, it achieves oracle F1 of 0.798 0.798 on CS-FLEURS, exceeding the CNN and HuBERT linear baselines. Its F1 on conversational SEAME speech is 0.734 0.734 . The most frequently selected Whisper-small dimension ranks in the top 1 % 1\% for 55.2 % 55.2\% of language pairs, compared with 5.3 % 5.3\% under random selection. Excluding both target languages when selecting dimension indices lowers CS-FLEURS F1 by 0.003 0.003 , while target-language monolingual speech is still used to estimate centroids. However, these results are based on benchmark datasets; we have not yet tested the detector as part of a mining pipeline on unlabelled, in-the-wild audio. It also requires a small labelled CS set to tune its decision rule. Future work will test candidate selection in that setting and investigate calibration with no CS labels.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个轻量级的CS探测器 用于从演讲中挑选候选人 它只用单一语言的语音来识别语言选择性的维度. 它拥有一个Whisper-小编码器层的大约1%-Q%,在CS-FLEURS上达到0.798 0.798的甲骨文F1,超过了CNN和HuBERT的线性基线. 其F1关于对话的SEAME演讲为0.734 0.734. 在55.2%的语言对等中,最经常被选中的Whisper-small维度排在前1%的1\%,而在随机选择下为5.3%的5.3%. 在选择维度指数时将两种目标语言都排除在外,CS-FLEURS F1降低0.0030.003;而目标语言单语语音仍然用于估计百分数. 然而,这些结果以基准数据集为基础;我们尚未测试探测器,作为未加标签的无线音频采矿管道的一部分。 还需要一个小的标有CS设置来调整其决定规则. 今后的工作将在这一设置中测试候选人的甄选情况,并调查没有CS标签的校准情况。
